body: Read-only ACP tool-level smoke test passed: adapter launched, authenticated with the existing Codex ChatGPT login, read README.md, and returned three suggestions; no files were changed. The full Mastra → model → tool route is not verified. llama3 returned an explicit does-not-support-tools error. qwen2.5-coder:7b is marked as tool-capable by installed Ollama but Mastra received plain assistant text and reported zero structured tool calls/results, so that response must not be treated as delegation. The local Ollama is 0.16.1; recommend updating before retrying the assistant path.
